comparison.objective: Hand-guide a carriage to two points while holding an enabling plunger in its middle band; candidate performs four tang break-offs.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous compliant carriage guidance with sustained switch control versus bimanual mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Two target points reached while the plunger remains in its allowed band versus four safe fractures and physical containment.
comparison.reason: The record tests simultaneous enabling and guided motion rather than impact fracture. Exact point and middle-band tolerances are not provided.
